questions: Measure cursor gaps, rotation/truncation, bounded summaries and missed-error risk.
Prune owned stale artifacts without deleting active diagnostic evidence or rereading entire logs.
decision: Preserve incremental cursors and explicit coverage gaps; add rotation recovery and owned retention rather than deleting logs to save prompt tokens.
code_observations: log_watch.scan tracks file device/inode and byte offset, keeps incomplete trailing lines for the next sample and reports skipped bytes with exit2.
digest reads a bounded prefix and reports truncation/omission. A small digest is not evidence that the entire source log was inspected.
The scan output truncates matching lines before any shared secret redactor is applied in that function; model-facing consumers need a defined sanitation boundary.
implementation_steps: Represent read coverage with start/end offsets, file identity, truncation/rotation events and omitted ranges. Do not convert a partial scan into a healthy result.
Test move/create and copytruncate rotation, same-size replacement, partial UTF-8 and very long lines. Choose explicit replay/deduplication policy for each case.
Apply sanitation before model-facing truncation and preserve bounded safe error signatures. Keep full raw logs only in owned access-controlled storage, not in prompts or packages.
Resume from cursor/digest checkpoints instead of rereading entire logs. Cursor corruption or uncertain identity should produce visible uncertainty and a bounded recovery path.
Prune only registered stale artifacts after acceptance and retention checks. Never let an observer delete active application logs or erase evidence needed by an unresolved failure.
proposed_acceptance_tests: An error split across two writes is detected once the line completes.
An omitted interval yields a coverage-gap status, never a claim of no errors.
Rotation/replacement does not inherit an unrelated offset silently.
A planted credential at a truncation boundary is absent from model-facing excerpts.
Cleanup preserves active/unresolved evidence and rejects unregistered paths and symlinks.

alternatives.title: Read full logs repeatedly or delete them after reading
alternatives.tradeoff: Either wastes tokens/I/O or destroys diagnostic evidence.

alternatives.title: Incremental coverage receipts plus guarded retention
alternatives.tradeoff: Bounded work with explicit missed-data risk and reproducible diagnosis.

alternatives.title: Optimize only for digest size
alternatives.tradeoff: Can hide errors and produce attractive but meaningless token-reduction percentages.

cost_model: Measure bytes actually read, duplicate bytes, omitted intervals, detection recall and digest size. The repository's synthetic >99% reduction is not a universal production saving.
unverified: Secret redaction is best effort, not a proof that arbitrary raw application output is safe to disclose. Sensitive logs may require stronger policy or no model access.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
